## Architecture Overview

The `kubernetes.Interface` (Clientset interface) in `k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes` is the typed client used by virtually every Kubernetes project. Adding a `HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error` method requires all implementations (including fakes and mocks) to add this method.

## Detailed Analysis

### Helm

- **`pkg/kube/client.go`** (line 95) — `kubeClient kubernetes.Interface` field, `getKubeClient()` creates Clientset via `Factory.KubernetesClientSet()`.
- **`pkg/kube/factory.go`** (line 22) — `KubernetesClientSet() (*kubernetes.Clientset, error)` interface definition.

### ArgoCD

- **`util/kube/util.go`** — `client kubernetes.Interface` parameter in `NewKubeUtil()`.
- **`gitops-engine/pkg/utils/kube/kube.go`** (line 104) — `kubernetes.NewForConfig()` call in `TestConfig()`.
- **`controller/appcontroller.go`** — Uses clientset for cluster interactions.
- **`server/server.go`** — Uses clientset for server operations.

### Cert-Manager

- **`pkg/controller/context.go`** (line 34) — `Client kubernetes.Interface` field, `buildClients()` creates via `kubernetes.NewForConfigAndClient()`.
- **`pkg/client/clientset/versioned/clientset.go`** — Custom clientset implementation.

### Grafana

- **`pkg/aggregator/generated/clientset/versioned/fake/clientset_generated.go`** — Fake clientset for tests.
- **`pkg/generated/clientset/versioned/fake/clientset_generated.go`** — Another fake clientset.

### OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib

- **`processor/k8sattributesprocessor/internal/kube/client.go`** (line 72) — `kc kubernetes.Interface` field.
- **`internal/k8sconfig/config.go`** — `kubernetes.NewForConfig()` central client creation.
